message.spiral_abyss.invalid_portal: Place the activation block in the top-center gap of a complete 5x6 Abyss gate, between two horizontal slabs, with its front and back faces pointing out of the gate.
message.spiral_abyss.blocked_portal: The portal opening must be empty, dry and inside the world border.
message.spiral_abyss.portal_overworld_on: Abyss portals can only be activated or reset in the Overworld.
message.spiral_abyss.portal_activated: Abyss portal activated. The first player to enter chooses the floor and hosts the party.
message.spiral_abyss.travel_unavailable: Dismount and stop sleeping before entering the Spiral Abyss.
message.spiral_abyss.spectator: Only living, non-spectator players can start or advance a floor.
message.spiral_abyss.already_running: A floor attempt is already running.
message.spiral_abyss.already_completed: This attempt is complete. Open its chest or use the Abyss menu to choose another floor.
message.spiral_abyss.peaceful: The Spiral Abyss requires Easy, Normal, or Hard difficulty.
message.spiral_abyss.missing_floor: Floor %s is unavailable. Add valid floor datapack files and /reload.
message.spiral_abyss.wrong_dimension: You must be inside the Spiral Abyss.
message.spiral_abyss.last_floor: You have finished all six Abyss floors.
message.spiral_abyss.spawn_failed: A wave could not spawn safely. Check the arena and server log, then retry.
message.spiral_abyss.spectating: You were defeated. Spectate until your team finishes.
message.spiral_abyss.reloaded: Datapacks reloaded; the current attempt was cancelled. Right-click the key to retry.
message.spiral_abyss.host_required: The host must be alive and present to start this floor.
message.spiral_abyss.host_only: Only the host can do this in their own Abyss arena.
message.spiral_abyss.claim_first: Open the reward chest before going to the next floor.
message.spiral_abyss.arenas_full: All 16 Abyss arenas are occupied, or the dimension is unavailable. Try again later.
message.spiral_abyss.party_unavailable: This party is already fighting. Join before the next attempt starts.
message.spiral_abyss.reset: Your six Abyss floors have been reset.
message.spiral_abyss.skip_floor: Floors 1-%s now have 9 stars and all chests marked looted. Selected floor: %s.
message.spiral_abyss.skip_floor_party_lo: Finish the shared chest payout before skipping floors.
message.spiral_abyss.floor_unavailable: That floor is unavailable. Choose a loaded floor from 1 to 6.
screen.spiral_abyss.unavailable: This floor is locked, or the current challenge or chest is unfinished.
message.spiral_abyss.challenge_result: Floor %s finished: %s/9 stars this attempt. Claim an earned chest to save your result.
message.spiral_abyss.global_reset: A new Abyss cycle has begun. All floors and rewards have reset; enter the portal to start again.
message.spiral_abyss.portal_selecting: The first player is choosing a floor. Enter again after they finish.
message.spiral_abyss.portal_busy: This portal is updating its party. Try again in a moment.
message.spiral_abyss.already_hosting: You already have a party in another arena. Return through its portal first.
message.spiral_abyss.selection_expired: Floor selection is no longer valid. Reopen the floor menu.
message.spiral_abyss.teleport_blocked: Teleport commands cannot move entities into, out of, or within the Spiral Abyss. Use the Abyss menu to leave.
message.spiral_abyss.personal_session: You entered your own floor %s. Continue here, or return through the Overworld portal to rejoin an idle host.
message.spiral_abyss.host_moved: The host changed floors. Open the Abyss menu to follow one floor at a time.
message.spiral_abyss.guest_transfer_bloc: Cannot change floors while %s cannot travel or has another reward chest pending.
message.spiral_abyss.host_changed: %s is now the Abyss party host.

screen.spiral_abyss.journal.rules: Earn 9 stars on a floor to unlock all 3 chests. Rare rewards appear only in floor 5 and 6 Golden Chests at 9 stars.
ui.spiral_abyss.help.horizontal.descript: Connect the top and base of the gate with horizontal slabs. Find frame pieces in Ruined Abyss Gate loot chests. Match the slab heights shown.
ui.spiral_abyss.help.vertical.descriptio: Use two vertical posts on each side, facing outward along the gate width. Find these frame pieces in Ruined Abyss Gate loot chests.
ui.spiral_abyss.help.curve.description: Use four inward-facing curves: bottom-half curves above, top-half curves below. Find these frame pieces in Ruined Abyss Gate loot chests.
ui.spiral_abyss.help.activation.descript: Found in End City loot chests and as a rare drop on Abyss floors 5 and 6. Use another Activation Block on an active portal to reset your personal rewards.
ui.spiral_abyss.help.overview.descriptio: Build this 5 × 6 gate in the Overworld. Keep its opening empty and dry. Hover over any block or label to learn more.
